verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor (APU) whose evidence covers silicon specs, runtimes, SDKs and model deployment. Plugging in MCP servers is an agent-client role, which is a category error for a chip. AMD's GAIA agent framework is mentioned, but nothing in the pack shows MCP-client support, so the exception that would make this axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
